title: Heritage Sites
subject: History (CDS/NDA)

blocks.heading: 🏛️ UNESCO World Heritage Sites in India
blocks.intro: India is home to **42 UNESCO World Heritage Sites** (as of recent evaluations), safeguarding rich cultural and natural history.

blocks.heading: 1. Classification
bullets: Cultural Sites (34): Man-made historical monuments. E.g., Sanchi Stupa, Taj Mahal, Ajanta/Ellora Caves, Group of Monuments at Hampi, Sun Temple at Konark, Khajuraho temples, Hill Forts of Rajasthan.

Natural Sites (7): Pristine ecosystems. E.g., Kaziranga National Park (Assam - one-horned rhinos), Sundarbans National Park (Bengal - mangroves, tigers), Western Ghats, Keoladeo National Park (Rajasthan - migratory birds).
Mixed Site (1): **Khangchendzonga National Park** (Sikkim). Holds both cultural significance for local tribes and unique alpine biodiversity.
Recent Inclusions: **Santiniketan (West Bengal):** University town founded by Rabindranath Tagore.
**Sacred Ensembles of the Hoysalas (Karnataka):** Star-shaped temples at Belur, Halebidu, and Somanathapura.

formulas: UNESCO count: 42 | Mixed: Khangchendzonga | Recent: Santiniketan, Hoysala temples
